requirements.statement: Users can sign in securely so that their task list is private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is redirected to sign in before seeing any tasks
A signed-in user only ever sees their own tasks, never another user's

requirements.statement: Users can add a new task with a short description

criteria.must: Submitting a non-empty task description creates a new active task
The newly created task appears in the user's task list

requirements.statement: Users can view their list of tasks

criteria.must: The task list view shows every task belonging to the signed-in user

requirements.statement: Users can mark a task as complete

criteria.must: Marking an active task complete changes its status to completed

requirements.statement: Users can un-mark a task as complete to reopen it

criteria.must: Un-marking a completed task changes its status back to active

requirements.statement: Users can edit a task's text

criteria.must: Editing a task's text and saving persists the new text
Deleting a task removes it from the user's task list

requirements.statement: Completed tasks are kept visually separate from active tasks

criteria.must: The task list renders active and completed tasks in visually distinct sections or groupings
